title: Execution Plan v2
description: Schema for oh-my-agents execution plans used by /spec-to-task and tracked by /harness-dashboard.

id.description: Unique plan identifier, must start with 'plan-'

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the plan

author.description: Who created this plan (human or agent identifier)

spec_ref.description: Reference to the original spec (file path, URL, or issue number)

id.description: Unique task identifier within the plan

phase.description: Dependency phase (1=types/config … 6=cross-cutting). Tasks in the same phase with no inter-dependency are parallelizable; see planner_metadata.parallelizable_groups.

constraints.description: What the agent must NOT do for this task (just as important as requirements) — e.g. 'no imports from service/'.

files.description: File paths this task will create or modify

depends_on.description: Task IDs that must complete before this task

context_files.description: Files the Generator should READ for context before implementing (distinct from `files`, which it creates/modifies). Lets a context-reset Generator self-brief without re-deriving the plan.

failing_tests.description: Tests that must FAIL before this task starts (test-first). Names the Evaluator's acceptance gate explicitly per the Planner/Generator/Evaluator topology.

notes.description: Implementation notes or context for the agent

planner_metadata.description: Optional typed hints for native Agent Teams / Dynamic Workflows executing this plan as the Planner→Generator handoff (Anthropic 3-agent topology). All advisory — executors adapt, never obey blindly.

parallelizable_groups.description: Groups of task ids with no inter-dependency that MAY run in parallel (e.g. one agent() per task). Derived from `depends_on`; advisory.

context_budget.description: Context-allocation hints so a Generator session sizes its work before a context reset.

on_fail.description: task id that, on failure, triggers re-running an earlier task

recovery_edges.description: Which earlier task to retry when a later task fails — supports the GAN-style Evaluator→Generator loop without losing Planner intent.

constraints.description: Architectural or process constraints for this plan

golden_principles.description: Project-specific golden principles that must not be violated
